scope: One real 2.9.2 client on loopback against the relay with --powerup-zones; findings 9.44

client.station_host: 127.0.0.2 (prepare_client --station, so the user's running host on 127.0.0.1 was left alone)

host.profile: local-relay, bound to 127.0.0.2 by a test-only launcher that overrides only the address
host.zones: the 11 kind-6 records of jrmap292.trn plus one synthetic Shield +5 zone, half-size 0, at (0, 0, 150), 150 units ahead of the slot-1 spawn

unpatched_2_9_2_behaviour.reason: SetTerrainType 0x49A560 puts type 6 in the case that clears +0x2FB; the collision pass 0x4B2E90 skips objects with +0x2FB clear (0x4B3013). 2.7.1's SetTerrainType 0x4EE130 marks type 6 collidable.

with_+0x2FB_set_in_memory.after_5_s: +0x2F7 back to 1 and +0x338 back to 0, but the model's enabled byte [+0x19C]+0x150 stayed 0, so it was neither drawn nor collidable; no second pickup

with_model_+0x150_also_set_in_memory.note: second pickup at once; the reappear countdown 0x49ABD0 sets only +0x2F7, never the model byte that the hide path 0x49CD70 cleared

not_verified: a second client seeing another player's pickup
the Missile, Shield +10/+20 and Repair effects
